items.name: Case Study Home
items.purpose: Introduce the public technical case study, display the no-affiliation/synthetic-data disclaimer, and route users to claim intake, claim tracking, or operator login.

data.name: case_study_identity_and_disclaimer
data.note: Content is derived from approved Discovery; it is not FAR branding or operational data.

items.responsive: Single-column mobile layout; wider desktop layout may present the three entry actions as distinct cards or panels.
accessibility: Disclaimer is readable and not conveyed by color alone

items.name: Verify Policy and Vehicle
items.purpose: Collect synthetic policy and vehicle references and request server-side verification before intake can continue.

data.name: policy_vehicle_verification
data.note: Authoritative API binding is intentionally unresolved until API Contract Design.

unresolved_api_needs: Policy/vehicle verification operationId, payload, abuse-control behavior and error contract must be reconciled after API Contract Design and final Interface Inventory.
items.responsive: One-column form on mobile; constrained form width on larger screens.

items.name: New Claim Intake
items.purpose: Capture required synthetic event data and permitted evidence after successful policy/vehicle verification.

data.name: verified_policy_vehicle_context
data.note: Read-only verified context from the server; exact binding deferred.

data.name: claim_draft_input
data.note: Client-side form state is not authoritative until server validation/submission.

unresolved_api_needs: Exact server validation payload and evidence-upload/submission transport contract must be defined by API Contract Design; the client must not invent server acceptance rules.
items.responsive: Form sections stack on mobile and may use grouped two-column layout only where labels/content remain readable on desktop.

items.name: Review and Confirm Claim
items.purpose: Present the pending synthetic claim for explicit customer confirmation before the authoritative submission mutation.

data.name: claim_review_summary
data.note: Review display reflects pending input; server remains authoritative at submission.

unresolved_api_needs: Claim-creation operationId, idempotency contract, response payload, validation errors and retry semantics must be established in API Contract Design.
items.responsive: Review sections stack on mobile; summary can use grouped panels on desktop.

items.name: Claim Submitted
items.purpose: Confirm successful claim creation and present the opaque tracking code plus synthetic next steps without exposing internal identifiers.

data.name: submission_receipt
data.note: Tracking code, initial public state and next steps come from the authoritative submission response; exact binding deferred.

unresolved_api_needs: Submission success response fields must be reconciled to the authoritative claim-creation operationId after API Contract Design.
items.responsive: Single-column receipt on mobile with tracking reference visually prioritized; wider centered receipt on desktop.
accessibility: Next-step content uses text rather than icon-only meaning

items.name: Track Claim Lookup
items.purpose: Collect opaque tracking code plus associated synthetic policy reference to request a customer-safe claim lookup.

data.name: tracking_lookup_input
data.note: Inputs are untrusted until validated by the server.

unresolved_api_needs: Tracking operationId, safe lookup failure semantics, rate limits and error payload must be defined by API Contract Design.
items.responsive: Compact one-column lookup form at all sizes with a constrained desktop width.
accessibility: Failure response does not expose which credential was wrong

items.name: Claim Status
items.purpose: Display only the customer-safe claim summary, current public status, public timeline and synthetic next steps returned by the authoritative tracking use case.

data.name: customer_safe_claim_status
data.note: Must exclude internal audit/security information; exact operationId deferred.

unresolved_api_needs: Customer-safe status/timeline response schema and canonical operationId must be reconciled after API Contract Design and final Interface Inventory.
items.responsive: Timeline collapses to a vertical mobile flow; desktop may use a summary panel beside the timeline when space permits.
accessibility: No meaning depends on color alone

items.name: Operator Login
items.purpose: Authenticate the demo Claims Operator before any backoffice claim data or mutations are available.

data.name: operator_credentials
data.note: Authentication is server-authoritative; exact token/session mechanism and operationId are Architecture/API decisions.

unresolved_api_needs: Authentication strategy, login operationId, credential payload, session/token lifecycle and error contract remain Architecture/API Contract decisions.
items.responsive: Single-column login form with constrained width on tablet/desktop.
accessibility: Authentication errors announced without exposing sensitive detail

items.name: Claims List
items.purpose: Allow an authenticated Claims Operator to review a compact list of synthetic claims and navigate to claim detail.

data.name: claims_collection
data.note: Server-authoritative collection; pagination/filter binding remains unresolved until API Contract Design.

unresolved_api_needs: Claims-list operationId, pagination/filter policy, authorization failures and response schema must be defined by API Contract Design.
items.responsive: Desktop table/list may become stacked claim summary cards or horizontally scroll-safe data presentation on narrow screens without hiding essential identifiers/state.
accessibility: Table/list has semantic headers or equivalent labels

items.name: Claim Detail and State Transition
items.purpose: Present authorized claim detail/evidence/history and allow only domain-approved state-transition requests for an authenticated Claims Operator.

data.name: claim_detail_and_history
data.note: Claim state/history/evidence metadata are server-authoritative; exact binding deferred.

data.name: available_transition_intent
data.note: UI must never invent lifecycle authority; final representation is decided in API Contract Design.

unresolved_api_needs: Claim-detail/evidence/transition operationIds, optimistic/concurrency behavior, audit-safe response fields and invalid-transition error semantics must be defined by API Contract Design.
items.responsive: Mobile stacks summary, evidence, timeline and actions; desktop may use a main detail column plus secondary status/action panel.
accessibility: Transition actions have explicit labels and confirmation where meaningful
